defaultAcceptance: Compare valid and invalid arities, NULLs, coercions, boundary values, warnings/errors, result bytes and column metadata against pinned MySQL; cover literals and stored columns over HTTP, wire text and prepared binary execution.

acceptanceByCategory.date-and-time-functions: Check all arities/units/directives, zero/invalid dates, negative and extended TIME, fractional precision, time zones/DST, statement stability and wrapped/direct wire metadata on both source versions.
acceptanceByCategory.aggregate-functions: Check empty/all-NULL groups, DISTINCT, duplicate keys, overflow/scale, collation, ordering/truncation, spill and window legality; compare values, warnings and metadata.
acceptanceByCategory.window-function-descriptions: Check peers/ties, empty and bounded frames, ROWS/RANGE defaults, named windows, NULL treatment, argument restrictions and partition/order types.
acceptanceByCategory.string-functions: Check bytes versus characters, NULL propagation, empty strings, multibyte text, collation, all optional arguments, output limits and metadata.
acceptanceByCategory.mathematical-functions: Check exact versus approximate operands, boundary/overflow/domain cases, signedness, NULLs, dynamic arguments, warnings and result types.
acceptanceByCategory.regexp: Compare ICU syntax/flags/positions/replacements, Unicode, binary rejection, invalid patterns and resource limits.
